title: xAI Grok 4.7 is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
xAI [Grok 4.7](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#grok-4-7) is now available on Unity Gateway. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs pay-per-token](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis#token-foundation-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
